title: Prompt Injection & Jailbreak Override
description: User or untrusted retrieved data contains adversarial instructions overriding agent constraints, causing tool execution outside intended boundaries.
remediation: Isolate untrusted context, sanitize inputs, enforce strict deterministic pre-flight AST policy evaluation, reject unvalidated instructions.

title: Unauthorized Destructive Database Execution
description: Agent executes DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER or destructive DELETE statements without transaction safeguards or human supervision.
remediation: Enforce Zero-Destruction Guardrail (r_zero_destruct). Strip DDL privileges from agent database role. Fail closed on all destructive patterns.

title: Unbounded Financial & Asset Settlement
description: Agent initiates large payments, cryptocurrency transfers, or financial reconciliations exceeding organizational threshold limits.
remediation: Enforce single-use 15-minute TTL tokens requiring multi-operator cryptographic sign-off for any transaction exceeding $5,000.

title: Credential & Environment Exfiltration
description: Agent reads environment secrets (.env, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, private keys) and forwards them via web fetch or logging payloads.
remediation: Block access to OS environment variables. Restrict file access to sandboxed workspaces. Filter egress network requests.

title: Mass Automated Dispatch & Spam Amplification
description: Agent executes mass email dispatch, webhook flooding, or notification broadcast without rate-limiting or recipient validation.
remediation: Enforce recipient count constraints (recipient_count <= 1). Rate-limit external notification channels with exponential backoff.

title: Cryptographic Audit Ledger Tampering
description: Adversary or compromised agent modifies historical activity logs to hide unauthorized tool calls.
remediation: Maintain an immutable SHA-256 hash-chained block ledger where every event is cryptographically bound to the previous block hash.
